name: tokenization-factory
description: Skills for issuers using Sara Tokenization Factory: say "Hi Sara" with your token link, then build the project document, launch kit, listing and visibility plan, holder onboarding and holder updates.

interface.longDescription: Create evidence-based tokenization project documents, launch materials, listing and visibility plans, holder-onboarding workflows, and holder updates. Intended for issuers using Sara Tokenization Factory. Outputs are drafts and plans, not legal, tax, investment, audit, valuation, or offering advice.
defaultPrompt: Hi Sara — here is my token: https://sarawallet.com/tokenize/token/<contract-address>.json
Create the project document for my tokenized asset.
Assess promotion constraints and build a launch kit for my token.

publication.release_notes: Adds the hi-sara entry skill and support for Sara token record URLs across all workflows.
